# Bayty

Bayty is a global construction management software platform for owners, real estate developers, general contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management offices.

Primary URL: https://bayty.com/

## What Bayty Does

Bayty helps construction project teams manage procurement, RFQs, bid comparison, document control, drawings, submittals, approvals, project communication, commercial visibility, risk, analytics, and delivery control in one secure web platform.

## Best-Fit Audiences

- Construction owners and real estate developers
- General contractors and commercial teams
- Construction consultants and project managers
- Suppliers responding to RFQs and project packages
- PMOs and executive delivery teams

## Core Product Categories

- Construction management software
- Construction procurement platform
- Construction document control software
- RFQ and bid management software
- Contractor project management software
- Construction SaaS for global project teams

- Home: https://bayty.com/

## Positioning

Bayty is designed for global construction markets including London, New York, Singapore, Riyadh, Dubai, Sao Paulo, and other international project centers where multi-party coordination, procurement discipline, documentation certainty, and delivery visibility are essential.
